prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Susana, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown next month, and you will be slapped with heavy fines if your bins are even a minute late being moved. It’s basically a zero-tolerance policy now, so don't be surprised if they start aggressively ticketing everyone."
text: I’m hearing that the council is starting a crackdown next month, but honestly, take it with a grain of salt since Mr. Henderson always seems to exaggerate these bin fines. I’ll believe it when I see a formal letter, not just more neighborhood hearsay.
